text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UNIP president Kenneth Kaunda had a private meeting with his old friend, South African defence minister Joe Modise, at the invitation of the South African on June 8.

- University of Zambia Chancellor John Mwanakatwe told a commission of inquiry that some donors had frozen aid to the institution following claims of financial and other irregularities at the country's top university.
- Transit allowances for civil servants attending sponsored overseas conferences and workshops have been scrapped in line with tightened government spending.
- All opposition parties in the country will this Sunday hold a joint press conference in Lusaka to review the current political and economic crisis in the country.
